2) New coverage: n2mb_draw_v2 23 checks (real n2r_build_v2 sidecar descriptor+plane captured from submitted command block; target/texture/heap/command retained through fakeJM completion; target write mask vs read-only texture; post-completion release; short span/kind/NULL refusal unchanged output; legacy v10 tail). ABI 3360-byte specialized plan: 16/48/3360 and bindings@32, vertex_constants@800, fragment_constants@1824, specialization_bytes@2848; ComputeRegion1184/local@12/flags@24/const_count@28/constants@32/push@1056; V2 11592 descriptors@72/regions@2120.
3) No hardware claim. Remaining explicit limits: exact sampler parity (integer/aniso/ClampZero vs opaque-white/normalized semantics), mips>1 and >16 layers transport, format83 not yet a linked real shader pipeline, and render's consumption of the specialized plan/compiler is outside this suite.
